lines: They readied their guns from all directions, in perfect sync.
Their machine guns sprayed fire simultaneously.
Mitsuki promptly created a tornado centred around herself and the others, and avoided the crossfire.
The violent airflow served as a barrier, and deflected the bullets that were fired into it one after another.
Stray bullets were sent flying everywhere, indiscriminately destroying everything: the table, the chairs, the tableware, the paintings on the walls...
And the women were no exception.
The bullets they themselves shot were being deflected, and causing a wave of friendly fire.
Making unpleasant sputtering sounds, bullets penetrated the women's bodies.
However, their bodies only wobbled from the impacts, and they calmly continued firing, without making so much as a tiny scream.
It was like they didn't feel pain.
There was no light of will in their eyes, their expressions were blank, and their movements were precise, like robots.
「They're not human anymore. They've lost their minds and lives as human beings, and been reduced to that man's puppets.」
That emotionless tone conversely gave a sense of bottomless anger.
The women were what remained of the slaves that had been collected, just like Sanada Homura.
Because they hadn't been deemed acceptable as the Lady's food, they had had their souls taken by the butler, and been made into puppets.
「I thought that might be it. How thoroughly distasteful.」
「Unfortunately, all we can do now that they've gotten that way is kill them. It's a mercy.」
「There's no time to be hanging around. We've got to act quickly, or Sanada Homura will be made that spider woman's afternoon snack.」
Though she felt sorry for them, she could do nothing to help.
In which case, as a Taimanin, there was only one thing to do.
「On my signal, I'm going to call off the wind. Please attack them without pause.」
「They don't feel pain. Please destroy them until they stop moving.」
She instructed calmly, as the commander.
「Well then, I guess I'll use this trick. I'm not fond of it, since it looks awful, though.」
Mutsuho gouged the nails of both hands into her own shoulders.
Poison slowly seeped out from her nails, and was injected into her own body.
Mutsuho's arms and legs, and all the muscles in her body, swelled up in front of their eyes.
She had mentioned on some occasion long ago.
That the Yanagi family had an Art called 「Tonic Toxin」, which temporarily boosted physical abilities by adjusting the composition of their poisons.
However, Mutsuho's expression also looked pained. There was no doubt that she was using this dangerous technique to the absolute limit of her body.
Her entire body was crackling with more sparks than ever.
As if to show the magnitude of her anger, one couldn't even tell her expression anymore because of the illumination from her electric glow.
She released the tornado that was guarding them, so as to push it towards the surrounding women as hard as possible.
The women's shooting was disrupted by the gust of wind.
Mutsuho swung her stout arm, which had swollen from the poison.
Making a sound which didn't seem at all like a person punching something, one woman had been slammed against the wall.
Just from that one blow, her body was pulverized, and the woman was freed from the curse of being a puppet.
Rin swung her electric blades downward.
An expressionless woman's body was cleaved in two, and burst into flames as it collapsed.
It was like Rin was trying to purify their defiled bodies with fire.
Mutsuho and Rin brought down the poor women one after another.
「How dare you break my precious puppets?」
「In that case, I will do the same to you.」
His was a feather-light manner of walking, as though he had no body weight, like his legs weren't touching the ground.
Shigemori took off his right glove, and held up his pale hand, which sprouted long claws.
He most likely used those claws to turn human beings into puppets.
With that piercing scream, Mitsuki swung her fan downwards, and slammed the lightly-approaching Shigemori with vacuum blades.
The butler's figure suddenly disappeared, as if melting into the darkness.
Immediately after that, she sensed “wind” above her head.
Mitsuki leaned her body to the right, and kicked off the floor as hard as she could.
Shigemori's claws passed chillingly right by the nape of her neck.
Having dodged the vacuum blades, he had made a surprise attack from the ceiling.
「No matter where you try to hide, the wind will tell me.」
If her reaction had been even a moment too late, she would have taken damage.
While feeling a cold sweat break out, Mitsuki readied her fan again.
Mutsuho and Rin were still engaging the women.
Right now, she had no choice but to fight on her own.
By the time she thought that, Mitsuki had already looked directly at that glow.
She could no longer take her eyes off him.
That man was so very beautiful, and charming, that... Yes... She wanted to devote all of herself to―――
Something had stuck into her rear.
The pain was so great that she nearly jumped upwards.
Her enthralled mindset had also been blown away.
Before Mitsuki's eyes was the figure of Shigemori.
He was now right on the brink of thrusting his claws into her.
And unleashed wind with all her might at Shigemori, who made an astonished expression.
「How dare you do that to me?!!!」
It was wind at point-blank range.
Even Shigemori could not escape that.
He was fully captured within the cage of wind that her tornado created.
This was the reverse form of the Vacuum Slash, which she had also used underground.
It didn't send vacuum blades flying all around, but captured the enemy within a cage of wind, and thrashed them exhaustively inside it.
It was a skill little different from torturing the enemy to death, in which hundreds of vacuum blades would cut them apart once they could no longer escape.
And Mitsuki had put that to use.
Within the cage of tempestuous wind, Shigemori had his entire body cut to shreds.
「Feel the pain of the girls you've made your puppets!!」
She swung her fan over and over and over again.
Channelling the bitter feelings of all of those women.
His death screams were gradually getting quieter, but
Even after they ceased to be heard at all, the vacuum maelstrom did not stop for some time.
By the time the wind stopped completely, Shigemori had been reduced to loose chunks of flesh and blood, to the point where one couldn't tell which part was which.
And by that point, all the women who had been turned into puppets had also been defeated.
「I sure wouldn't want to get on the President's bad side.」
Mutsuho called out to her, with a kind-of-impressed, kind-of-shocked expression.
Her Tonic Toxin Art had now worn off, and her body had returned to normal.
Mitsuki pulled out the fine needle that had been pricking her buttock, and returned it to Mutsuho.
「It's got a stimulant toxin in it. Worked well, didn't it?」
After saying thanks to Mutsuho once again, she looked around the dining room, which had fallen silent.
Some of the women who had been made into puppets had had their bodies completely destroyed, and others had been burned right in half.
They wouldn't have even known their individual names anymore.
But surely not a single one of them would have wanted to meet such a cruel end.
Even though there had been no other way, her chest hurt like it was being squeezed.
「I'm sorry I couldn't save you all.」
While feeling tears welling up, she bowed deeply to the women.
「There are still people we can save. Let's go.」
Having her shoulder gently patted by Rin, Mitsuki wiped away her tears.
